sources.summary: In a new series, we review the best art exhibitions currently showing in commercial galleries, where entrance is free Walking into Gabriel Orozco’s show is like waking up with a headache and trying to piece together whatever the hell you did last night. Everything in the Mexican conceptualist’s exhibition is splintered, disjointed, a history you can’t make sense of. Continue reading...
